summary: End-to-end test of new Rental KYC booking flow (backend + frontend). Backend: created dedicated test_rentals_kyc.py — 7/7 tests pass, all KYC fields persist, status='Booked', driver sees Booked rentals, price variants (99/189/349/149/249) all echo back correctly. Updated existing test_ride_workflow.py to expect status='Booked' (was 'Requested'). Full regression suite: 22/22 backend tests pass. Frontend: modal opens on all 5 Book buttons with correct testids, price sync verified end-to-end (rental card ₹ == rental-kyc-price == Confirm button ₹ == My Rides amount) for Bike 99/189/349, Auto 149, Car 249 — ALL identical. Aadhar/Driving Licence toggle changes label correctly ('Aadhar Number' ↔ 'Driving Licence Number'). Successful booking flips button to 'Booked' with bg-blue-800 + disabled + checkmark. Success banner shows. My Rides shows Rental card + rental-kyc-panel-* with Aadhar/Age/Vehicle No/Color/KM Driven/Address as expected.

issues: Custom validation red banners specified in the spec ('Please enter a valid Aadhar / Driving Licence number', 'Renter must be 18+ years old', 'Please enter the vehicle registration number') are effectively unreachable because every input has HTML5 `required` attribute — the browser's native tooltip ('Please fill out this field.') fires first and blocks form submission before the JS validation in submitRentalBooking() runs. To make the custom banners reachable, remove `required` from the inputs (or replace with noValidate on the <form>) so the JS validation path can execute.

action_items: OPTIONAL UX: Decide whether to keep HTML5 `required` (native tooltip) or the custom red banner. Currently native tooltip wins; the spec asked for the custom banner. Fix by adding `noValidate` to the modal <form> or removing `required` attributes so submitRentalBooking() JS validation is reachable.

OPTIONAL: bookedRentalKeys is only in-memory (React state). If user reloads, 'Booked' pill on already-booked package resets to 'Book'. Consider deriving the booked set from GET /api/rentals so the state survives reload.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py L917-948: create_rental correctly persists all 7 new KYC fields and sets status='Booked'. Returns doc with _id excluded via dict-comp — good.
server.py L956-961: driver rentals query correctly includes {status: {$in: ['Booked','Requested']}} — backward compatible with old records.
App.js L378-382: JS validation logic is correct, but currently unreachable because inputs have HTML5 `required` attribute (see design_issues).
App.js L399: bookedRentalKeys key `${vehicleType}-${price}` — collides if two packages of same vehicle+price ever exist (not the case today, but fragile). Prefer package.name key.
App.js L369: bookedRentalKeys not derived from server data on load — 'Booked' UI resets on page refresh.

success_rate.frontend: 100% functional (1 minor UX note on validation banner visibility)
